components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action in panels and dialogs; Signal Blue in dark mode.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: hsl(240 5.9% 10%); color: hsl(0 0% 98%); height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(240 5.9% 10% / .9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(240 10% 3.9%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: hsl(0 0% 100%); color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90%); border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(240 10% 3.9%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Text and numeric entry; 16px on phones.
components.css: .ds-input { background: hsl(0 0% 100%); color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90%); border-radius: 6px; font: 400 14px/1.4 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(240 10% 3.9%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Sidebar section tabs on a Zinc Wash rail.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-tab { border: 0; background: transparent; color: hsl(240 3.8% 40%); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 12px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab-active { background: hsl(0 0% 100%); color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(240 10% 3.9%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Parameter Slider
components.description: The signature control: label and mono value with unit, track below.
components.html: Pipe diameter42.0 mm
components.css: .ds-param { display: grid; gap: 6px; width: 260px; font: 500 12px/1.33 system-ui, sans-serif; color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); } .ds-param-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-param-val { font: 400 12px/1.33 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: hsl(240 3.8% 40%); } .ds-param-range { width: 100%; accent-color: hsl(240 5.9% 10%); } .ds-param-range:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(240 10% 3.9%); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The Studio is a workbench: a dense instrument panel beside a large 3D viewport, in which the object being configured is the only thing with colour and depth. The chrome is a stock shadcn/ui kit on a zinc neutral scale, a system font, and one accent that changes with the theme. The world is coherent but not authored; the pre-P2 world workshop exists to close that gap.
keyCharacteristics: One shared token file for the Studio and the landing.
System UI font for chrome; monospace for numeric values.
Tonal layering and translucent blurred panels; shadows are rare.
44 px targets on primary controls; safe-area utilities.

rules.name: The Readable Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent-coloured text below 24 px uses primary-readable, never primary.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: New UI colours come from the token file; hard-coded palette utilities and raw hex in chrome are recorded drift, not precedent.

rules.name: The Error Text Rule
rules.body: Error and constraint text must clear 4.5:1; --destructive is a fill, not a text colour, until a readable error token exists.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: A number the visitor can act on is set in the mono face, with its unit.

rules.name: The 16 px Field Rule
rules.body: On viewports under 768 px, fields are 16 px so mobile browsers do not zoom on focus.

rules.name: The Object Has The Depth Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays flat and translucent so the configured object is the deepest thing on screen.

dos: Do take every colour from packages/tokens/colors.css through hsl(var(--token)).
Do use primary-readable for accent text under 24 px.
Do set acted-on numbers in the mono face with their unit.
Do keep 44 px targets on primary controls and the 16 px field size on phones.
donts: Don't add new hard-coded Tailwind palette colours or raw hex in chrome; add a token.
Don't give chrome real shadows or depth that competes with the 3D object.
Don't introduce a new font, radius or accent before the pre-P2 world workshop decides the Studio's world.
